summary.en-US: Copy your YouTube Music login in the format Music Assistant needs, or send it straight to your Music Assistant server.

description.en-US:
Music Assistant's YouTube Music provider needs your login cookie as one line of text. Other cookie exporters produce a Netscape cookies.txt file, and Music Assistant cannot use that. This add-on gives you the right format instead.

You can copy the cookie, or send it straight into Music Assistant. Sign in to Music Assistant from the add-on, through Home Assistant or with a Music Assistant account. There is no token to make or paste.

Press Find my server and the add-on looks for Music Assistant at the usual addresses. A welcome page opens after install and walks you through setup.

It works on Firefox for Android and Firefox on desktop, so you can set up YouTube Music from your phone. You need a Music Assistant server with the YouTube Music provider, and an admin account on it.

Use a private window: sign in at music.youtube.com, open a playlist, then press the add-on's button. Close the window without signing out.

Privacy: the cookie is a full login to your Google account. The add-on never stores it, and only sends it to the Music Assistant address you set, when you press Send. It sends nothing anywhere else.

Not affiliated with Google, YouTube, Home Assistant, Music Assistant or the Open Home Foundation.
